items.question: How much x402 activity is real commerce?
items.context: Raw counters, Visa and Artemis adjusted figures and academic counts disagree by an order of magnitude, and the x402.org counter has shown the same values since at least 2025-12-14 (Wayback Machine). Artemis keeps its detection logic private and arXiv:2607.12575 uses its own method; no shared, published labeling method was found on 2026-10-19.

items.question: Will a2a-x402 be updated for AP2 v0.2?
items.context: The a2a-x402 v0.2 embedded flow puts requirements in an AP2 v0.1 CartMandate, which AP2 v0.2 no longer has. The two transport specs also use different extension URIs.

items.question: Can payment and delivery be made atomic?
items.context: Each payment flow shifts risk to one side. A402 proposes Atomic Service Channels; auth-capture adds refunds but not proof of delivery.

items.question: How decentralized will facilitation be in practice?
items.context: Anyone can run a facilitator, yet in arXiv:2607.19545's sample (Base and Solana, 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-26) Coinbase's handled 77.17M of about 119.7M x402 transactions, and the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway also settles through it. The eight facilitator security rules from that paper are not part of the spec.

items.question: What will the identity, tax and card-acceptance working groups produce?
items.context: The x402 Foundation has wg-identity, wg-tax, wg-card-acceptance and wg-domain-discovery repositories. On 2026-10-19 the identity, tax and card-acceptance repositories held only a README and a license; the domain-discovery group had merged a draft verifier response schema on 2026-10-02, and a draft card binding for auth-capture (x402 PR #3707) was still unmerged.

items.question: Will SDK parity catch up?
items.context: TypeScript covers 13 network families; no SDK implements the Lightning binding; Python lacks auth-capture and Solana upto and batch-settlement; offer-receipt is TypeScript only; the Java module is unpublished; x402-a2a is not on PyPI.

items.question: Should payment metadata be minimized by the spec?
items.context: Resource URLs and descriptions reach facilitators that may not have data agreements with payers; research proposes filtering middleware, but the spec has no rule.

items.question: Will the GitHub advisories get CVE identifiers, and when will the foundation's bug bounty start?
items.context: Neither high-severity advisory had a CVE id on 2026-10-19. Since 2026-10-15 SECURITY.md routes vulnerability reports to the x402 Foundation (a TSC member or a primary maintainer, privately through the x402 Slack) and says a bug bounty program is coming soon.
